verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the 9-streets area on the Keizersgracht canal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the “9-streets” area on the prestigious “Keizersgracht” canal

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Amsterdam's historic heart, steps from the Nine Streets, the Jordaan, museums and independent boutiques.
verified_facts.excerpt: In Amsterdam’s historic heart, steps from the Nine Streets, Jordaan, celebrated museums and independent boutiques.

verified_facts.text: The Keizersgracht, where the hotel sits, is the widest canal in the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the widest canal in the city (Keizersgracht)

verified_facts.text: The address was once home to the first theater in Amsterdam, dating back to the 1600s, before becoming Hotel Blakes.
verified_facts.excerpt: This address was once home to the first theater in Amsterdam (dating back to the 1600s and Dutch painter Rembrandt van Rijn once worked as a production assistant here) before becoming Hotel Blakes, its preceding name to The Dylan.

verified_facts.text: Guests enter through a small courtyard and a residential-style door.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entering through a small courtyard, guests discover a residential-style door where you feel as if you are visiting a friend’s home rather than a hotel.

verified_facts.text: Several buildings are connected by stairs and pathways, with tiny gardens or patios, seating nooks and cozy spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: a maze of hallways, staircases, tiny gardens or patios, seating nooks, and plenty of cozy spaces

verified_facts.text: The hotel has four different room styles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our four different room styles.

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Duplex Room, known as a staircase room, is arranged over two floors connected by a steep internal staircase.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Luxury Duplex Room, also uniquely known as a staircase room, is arranged over two floors connected by a steep internal staircase, with the bedroom and bathroom located on separate floors.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suites Canal View are in the Serendipity building, in Serendipity style with natural warming shades of brown and grey.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Junior Suites Canal View are located in “the Serendipity building” in Serendipity style with natural warming shades of brown and grey

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a B&O sound system, an Illy espresso maker and Aesop bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: B&O sound system with Bluetooth connection, Illy espresso maker and Aesop bath amenities

verified_facts.text: Double Rooms in the Original building look over the garden; those in the Serendipity building look over the atrium.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Double Rooms are located in “the Original building” with a view over the garden and in “the Serendipity building” a view over the atrium.

verified_facts.text: Turndown service delivers Amsterdam stroopwafels made by the nearby Lanskroon bakery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Turndown service delivers delicious Amsterdam stroopwafels, produced by nearby Lanskroon bakery

verified_facts.text: Restaurant Vinkeles is situated in an 18th-century bakery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Restaurant Vinkeles, situated in an 18th century bakery

verified_facts.text: Bar Brasserie OCCO is known for its High Wine, a take on High Tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Informal Bar Brasserie OCCO is famous for its “High Wine” experience, our fun take on High Tea.

verified_facts.text: Hand-crafted Roetz electric bikes are available for guests to borrow free of charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hand-crafted Roetz electric bikes are available for guests to borrow free of charge to cycle around town like a local.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have a pool; it has a gym and offers in-room treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Dylan does not have a pool, it does have a well equiped Gym and offers in-room treatments.

verified_facts.text: Les Clefs d'Or concierges can reserve valet parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contact the Les Clefs d’Or Concierges to reserve valet parking

verified_facts.text: The concierge team curates itineraries, from museum reservations and private art guides to countryside excursions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our concierge team is delighted to curate bespoke itineraries, from museum reservations and private art guides to countryside excursions and dining experiences

verified_facts.text: The hotel once opened as Blakes Amsterdam and is now a Leading Hotel of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once opened as the almost legendary Blakes Amsterdam, now evolved to a Leading Hotel of The World where quiet luxury speaks.

verified_facts.text: The city and the hotel are not easy to maneuver around for those with mobility issues.
verified_facts.excerpt: remember that the city (and this hotel) are not as easy to maneuver around for those with mobility issues

verified_facts.text: Kids are not always common but are welcome and well cared for.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids are not always common, but welcome and well cared for here.
